entries: Added `/claude-api api-version` to move Claude API code to API version `2026-10-21`
Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` is set and the model is an alias with the `[1m]` suffix, such as `opus[1m]`
Fixed the `prompt-caching-scope` beta header being sent behind custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect
Fixed MCP servers showing "needs authentication" in `claude -p` on macOS while the login keychain was locked; they now say why, and the next run after an unlock connects without a new sign-in
Fixed MCP servers being reported as timed out, and staying failed in headless runs, when a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while they were connecting
Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried
Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running
Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results
Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted
Fixed a conversation cleared with `/clear` sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted
Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions
Fixed telemetry from Claude Desktop sessions behind a Claude apps gateway being rejected when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` is set

Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description
Fixed `/help` and the `/` command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as `/claude-api` instead of their short descriptions
Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses
Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds
Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file
Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions
Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab
Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection
Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session
Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held
Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error
Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work
Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load
Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authentication error"
Improved the time to the first reply in cloud sessions when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect
Improved Remote Control connect time for sessions whose transcript contains large pasted images or PDF reads
Changed the notice Claude gets when the WebSearch budget is used up to also tell it not to query search engines in a browser or through computer use
Changed the `axScreenReader` setting and `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` in a settings `env` block to apply only from user, managed or `--settings` settings (since 2.1.305)
Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0`
Self-hosted runner: Changed the certificate file built for Anthropic-managed git to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does; a `[runner:warn]` line gives the number left out
[VSCode] Added a notice on the microphone button when voice dictation stops by itself (15 seconds without recognized speech, or the 2-minute limit), saying why and that the text so far is kept
[VSCode] Fixed a long prompt expanded with Show more covering the whole chat panel: a pinned prompt is now capped at 40% of the panel and scrolls
[VSCode] Fixed part of a list item or table cell with LaTeX math pasting as a new list or table in rich text editors
[VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`
[VSCode] Changed the "still open somewhere else" notice to also cover a Claude process left over from an extension restart, which usually ends on its own within about 10 minutes
[VSCode] Changed voice dictation to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does
[VSCode] Changed the extension's own requests to filter their trusted certificates as the CLI does, and to trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file named in the environment or in user settings
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the repository picker saying "No repositories match" while a search was still running; it now shows "Searching…" until the results arrive
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the "Waiting for a runner" status on self-hosted environments being cut off; with on-demand runners it now counts up from your last message and shows failed attempts
[Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review

title.zh-TW: Code Review 支援停止指令，快速解除 PR 自動審查
title.en: Code Review adds stop commands to end automatic PR reviews

body.zh-TW: 當你在 GitHub 的拉取請求（Pull Request）啟用自動審查後，若是功能已經測試完畢準備合併，往往不需要機器人再次介入。⟦跟退訂每日鮮乳配送一樣，以前聯絡客服終止可能還會多送一天的牛奶，現在辦理完成立即停送，不會在退訂當天又往門口放一瓶多餘的飲品。⟧現在 Code Review 新增了 `@claude review stop` 指令，同時也支援 `@claude review off` 與 `@claude review pause`。輸入後能直接結束該拉取請求上的 `@claude review always` 訂閱，而且不會觸發新一輪審查。在合併程式碼的最後關頭，你可以俐落收尾，不必再被多餘的審查留言打擾。
body.en: After you enable automatic reviews on a GitHub pull request, you often do not need the bot to step in again once the feature has been tested and is ready to merge. ⟦Canceling a daily milk delivery used to mean contacting customer service and possibly receiving milk for another day. Now deliveries stop as soon as the cancellation is processed, without an extra bottle arriving at your door that day.⟧ Code Review now supports `@claude review stop`, along with `@claude review off` and `@claude review pause`. These commands directly end the `@claude review always` subscription for that pull request without triggering another review. As you prepare to merge the code, you can wrap things up without extra review comments getting in the way.

items.original: [Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review

title.zh-TW: 內建指令選單顯示精簡描述，新增 API 版本切換
title.en: Built-in command menus show shorter descriptions and add API version switching

body.zh-TW: 平常在終端機按下 `/` 或是輸入 `/help` 查詢功能時，畫面呈現的整潔度直接影響尋找指令的效率。以前針對 `/claude-api` 等內建技能，清單會直接倒出寫給模型閱讀的長篇說明，把選單畫面撐得相當冗長。⟦讀者翻閱工具書的索引目錄時，以前條目旁印滿給排版校對看的長篇備註，現在全部換回簡短摘要，版面呈現乾淨明瞭。⟧現在選單已改為顯示給使用者看的精簡說明，閱讀起來不再雜亂。若你需要將專案內的 Claude API 程式碼推進至 `2026-10-21` 版本，直接輸入 `/claude-api api-version` 即可快速遷移。
body.en: When you press `/` in the terminal or enter `/help` to look up features, a tidy display directly affects how quickly you can find a command. For built-in skills such as `/claude-api`, the list previously displayed lengthy instructions written for the model, making the menu cumbersome. ⟦When readers browsed a reference book's index, entries used to be crowded with long notes intended for typesetters and proofreaders. Those notes have now been replaced with short summaries, leaving the layout clear and easy to read.⟧ The menu now shows concise descriptions written for users, making it easier to read. If you need to migrate your project's Claude API code to version `2026-10-21`, enter `/claude-api api-version` to make the switch quickly.

items.original:
Added `/claude-api api-version` to move Claude API code to API version `2026-10-21`
Fixed `/help` and the `/` command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as `/claude-api` instead of their short descriptions

title.zh-TW: 安全事件支援遙測追蹤，權限清單清楚列出被拒指令
title.en: Safety events gain telemetry tracking, and permission lists identify denied commands

body.zh-TW: 當你透過自動模式或安全規則控管各項工具時，操作被擋下的細節與放行流程現在更加清楚。只要工具呼叫被權限規則、自動模式、安全檢查、掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）或沙盒阻止、提示或退回，OpenTelemetry 都會記錄 `claude_code.safety_event` 遙測事件。以前在 `/permissions` 的 Recently denied 畫面中不會顯示被拒絕的 shell 指令，且自動模式的本機分類器在審查重試指令時還會忽略此處的核准；現在核准記錄會直接標明具體指令名稱而非抽象描述。當網頁搜尋預算耗盡時，通知也會同步告誡 Claude 不得透過瀏覽器或電腦操作（computer use）轉向外部搜尋引擎查詢。以前指令被擋下後難以追查原貌、核准重試又可能再次受阻，現在每一道安全關卡都有跡可循，放行指令也能正確生效。
body.en: When you control tools through auto mode or safety rules, the details of blocked actions and the approval process are now clearer. Whenever permission rules, auto mode, safety checks, hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), or the sandbox block a tool call, prompt for approval, or send it back, OpenTelemetry records a `claude_code.safety_event` telemetry event. Previously, the Recently denied view in `/permissions` did not show denied shell commands, and auto mode's local classifier ignored approvals made there when reviewing retried commands. Approval records now identify the specific command rather than giving an abstract description. When the web search budget runs out, the notification also tells Claude not to turn to external search engines through the browser or computer use (operating a computer's interface). Previously, it was difficult to trace the original command after it was blocked, and an approved retry could be blocked again. Now each safety check leaves a record, and command approvals take effect correctly.

items.original:
Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description
Changed the notice Claude gets when the WebSearch budget is used up to also tell it not to query search engines in a browser or through computer use

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 工具連線與休眠逾時，避免重複發送寫入請求
title.en: MCP connection and sleep timeout fixes prevent duplicate write requests

body.zh-TW: 當你依賴 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充功能時，以下連線問題已修好。在 macOS 上，若登入鑰匙圈鎖定，`claude -p` 會說明驗證受阻的原因，解鎖後下次執行便能連線，無須重新登入。過去 macOS 或 Linux 電腦在 MCP 伺服器連線途中進入睡眠，伺服器會被回報為逾時，並在無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）下一直顯示失敗，這已修好。HTTP 呼叫中途斷線時，現在僅限唯讀或具備冪等特性（重做也不改變結果）的工具才會自動重試，避免寫入操作觸發兩次。背景任務執行時，新一輪對話有時未取得 SDK MCP 伺服器的最新工具，這已修好。桌面版 Code 標籤頁中，直接設定的 GitHub MCP 伺服器寫入工具，表單關閉後未建立內容的狀況也已修正。
body.en: If you rely on MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) for added functionality, the following connection problems have been fixed. On macOS, if the login keychain is locked, `claude -p` explains why authentication is blocked. After unlocking it, the next run can connect without requiring you to log in again. Previously, if a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while connecting to an MCP server, the server was reported as timed out and continued to appear failed in headless mode (running without a visual interface). This has been fixed. If an HTTP call loses its connection midway, automatic retries are now limited to tools that are read-only or idempotent (repeating the operation does not change the result), preventing writes from being triggered twice. A new conversation turn sometimes failed to get the latest tools from SDK MCP servers while background tasks were running; this has been fixed. In the desktop app's Code tab, write tools from directly configured GitHub MCP servers showed a form that closed without creating anything. This has also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers showing "needs authentication" in `claude -p` on macOS while the login keychain was locked; they now say why, and the next run after an unlock connects without a new sign-in
Fixed MCP servers being reported as timed out, and staying failed in headless runs, when a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while they were connecting
Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried
Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running
Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab

title.zh-TW: 子代理避免重複接工，工具呼叫格式錯誤時支援自動重試
title.en: Subagents avoid duplicate assignments, and malformed tool calls can retry automatically

body.zh-TW: 當你借助子代理或 Agent SDK 執行複雜的多工流程時，多項非同步協作的容錯機制已完成補強。針對同時啟動的多個 fork 子代理，現在各自分發時會明確指派身分，不再容易互相搶接對方的工作。⟦工廠領班指派多人協同組裝時，以前組員容易爭搶同一份工單，現在每個人都清楚領取專屬工作卡，遇到辨識不清的指示還會主動重新確認，最多兩次。⟧工具呼叫無法解析時，現在最多重試兩次；仍無法解析才會報錯並結束這一輪。在文字稿記錄方面，串流回應不再填入佔位的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數值與空白停止原因；透過 SDK 的 `setModel()` 切換模型時，確認等待時間也由 5 秒放寬至 15 秒。這些調整減少了自動化流程中的非預期中斷，讓複雜排程執行得更平穩。
body.en: If you use subagents or the Agent SDK for complex multitasking workflows, several safeguards for asynchronous collaboration have been strengthened. Multiple fork subagents launched at the same time now receive explicit identities when dispatched, making them less likely to take each other's assignments. ⟦When a factory foreman assigned several workers to assemble something together, workers used to compete for the same work order. Now each worker clearly receives a dedicated job card and actively asks for clarification when instructions are unclear, up to two times.⟧ Tool calls that cannot be parsed now retry up to two times. An error is reported and the turn ends only if parsing still fails. In transcripts, streaming responses no longer include placeholder token (a unit of text AI processes and bills for) counts or empty stop reasons. When switching models through the SDK's `setModel()`, the wait for confirmation has also been extended from 5 seconds to 15 seconds. These changes reduce unexpected interruptions in automated workflows and help complex schedules run more smoothly.

items.original:
Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses
Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds
Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error
Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work

title.zh-TW: 修正自訂閘道標頭與遙測錯誤，完善模型設定判定
title.en: Custom gateway header and telemetry fixes improve model setting handling

body.zh-TW: 若你使用自訂 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 閘道（代為轉送連線請求的中間服務）或 Foundry，無效的 prompt-caching-scope 標頭已不再送出。Claude apps 閘道工作階段不再忽略 CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS；其 Claude Desktop 工作階段設定 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS 後遙測遭拒的問題已修復。CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT 搭配帶 [1m] 的模型別名時不再報錯找不到模型。Artifact 讀取重用連線遭伺服器關閉時不再出現連線重設錯誤。自 2.1.305 起，axScreenReader 與 env 區塊中的 CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER，只從使用者、受管理或 --settings 生效。
body.en: If you use a custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL gateway (an intermediary service that forwards connection requests) or Foundry, the invalid prompt-caching-scope header is no longer sent. Claude apps gateway sessions no longer ignore CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS. Telemetry rejection after setting OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS in their Claude Desktop sessions has been fixed. Using CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT with a model alias containing [1m] no longer produces a model-not-found error. Artifact reads no longer produce connection reset errors when the server has closed a reused connection. Starting with 2.1.305, axScreenReader and CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER in the env block take effect only from user settings, managed settings, or --settings.

Fixed the `prompt-caching-scope` beta header being sent behind custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect
Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions
Fixed telemetry from Claude Desktop sessions behind a Claude apps gateway being rejected when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` is set
Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection
Changed the `axScreenReader` setting and `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` in a settings `env` block to apply only from user, managed or `--settings` settings (since 2.1.305)

title.zh-TW: 瀏覽器登入即刻顯示成功頁面，加快遠端與雲端連線速度
title.en: Browser sign-in shows success immediately, and remote and cloud connections are faster

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟瀏覽器登入帳號或使用遠端連線功能時，整體等待體驗與狀態回報已獲得多項改進。現在瀏覽器登入只要一完成，瀏覽器便會立刻跳出成功畫面，不需要乾等帳號個人資料慢慢載入。桌面應用有某個 MCP 外部工具伺服器連不上時，雲端工作階段等待首次回覆的時間也縮短了。如果對話文字稿中塞滿了貼上的大型圖片或 PDF 讀取內容，遠端控制（Remote Control）的連線建立過程也變得更快。透過桌面應用程式封存閒置工作階段而中止的背景指令，通知會清楚標明輸出檔案名稱，不再向 Claude 誤報成是使用者手動停止。
body.en: When you sign in through a browser or use remote connections, several changes improve waiting times and status reporting. As soon as browser sign-in finishes, the browser now immediately shows a success page without waiting for account profile data to load. In cloud sessions, the wait for the first response is shorter when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect. Remote Control connections also start faster when the conversation transcript contains large pasted images or PDF content that has been read. When archiving an idle session through the desktop app stops a background command, the notification clearly identifies the output filename and no longer incorrectly tells Claude that the user stopped it manually.

items.original:
Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file
Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load
Improved the time to the first reply in cloud sessions when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect
Improved Remote Control connect time for sessions whose transcript contains large pasted images or PDF reads

title.zh-TW: 修正對話自動精簡震盪，避免重啟後舊訊息復活
title.en: Fixes reduce autocompaction thrashing and keep cleared messages from returning after restarts

body.zh-TW: 長時間對話並夾帶大量圖表資料時，歷史訊息的壓縮與清理機制決定了對話能否順利延續。⟦辦公室碎紙機處理厚重的設計圖冊時，以前一次塞入太多大張圖紙容易反覆卡紙倒退，清空後的廢紙匣在重開電源後竟然還會把舊草稿吐出來；現在卡紙少了一些，清空的廢紙匣也不會再吐出舊草稿。⟧過去在單一輪次中讀取大量 PDF 頁面、圖片或龐大工具輸出時，可能出現「Autocompact is thrashing」錯誤，代表自動精簡反覆震盪；這次修好了其中一部分情況。在雲端工作階段中，自訂的 `/autocompact` 視窗範圍在工作階段重新啟動後不會再跳回預設值。透過 `/clear` 清除的對話紀錄，在雲端或自託管執行器重啟後，也不會再莫名其妙復活。
body.en: In long conversations with lots of charts and other data, the way message history is compressed and cleared determines whether the conversation can continue smoothly. ⟦When an office shredder handled a thick book of design drawings, feeding in too many large sheets used to make it repeatedly jam and reverse. Even an emptied waste bin would spit out old drafts after the power was turned back on. Now there are fewer jams, and an emptied bin no longer spits out old drafts.⟧ Previously, reading many PDF pages, images, or large tool outputs in a single turn could cause an “Autocompact is thrashing” error, meaning automatic compaction was repeatedly oscillating. Some of these cases have been fixed. In cloud sessions, a custom `/autocompact` window range no longer resets to its default after the session restarts. Conversation history cleared with `/clear` also no longer unexpectedly returns after a cloud or self-hosted runner restarts.

items.original:
Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results
Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted
Fixed a conversation cleared with `/clear` sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted

title.zh-TW: 雲端搜尋提供即時進度回饋，網頁讀取錯誤回歸正常結果
title.en: Cloud search shows live progress, and web fetch failures return normal results

body.zh-TW: 當你在雲端環境挑選儲存庫或讓 Claude 抓取網頁資料時，多處介面狀態與錯誤回饋現在更為貼近真實情況。在儲存庫選擇器中，搜尋進行中會明確顯示「Searching…」，不會再於結果抵達前誤跳「找不到相符儲存庫」的假警報。面對自託管環境，「Waiting for a runner」的等待提示不再被截斷，若是隨選執行器，還會從你最後一則訊息起算等待秒數，並顯示失敗次數。在網路擷取方面，Cowork 雲端工作階段的 WebFetch 遇到網站回傳 4xx 狀態碼或 robots.txt 阻擋時，會如同本機環境般作為一般結果呈現，不再拋出工具錯誤。在雲端或自託管執行器工作階段，搜尋遭 403 拒絕且回應附有原因時，現在會顯示該原因，不再只顯示驗證錯誤（Authentication error）。
body.en: When you select a repository in the cloud or have Claude fetch web content, several interface states and error messages now more accurately reflect what is happening. The repository picker explicitly shows “Searching…” while a search is running, instead of prematurely showing a false “No repositories match” message before results arrive. In self-hosted environments, the “Waiting for a runner” message is no longer cut off. For on-demand runners, it also shows the seconds spent waiting since your last message and the number of failures. For web fetching, when a website returns a 4xx status code or robots.txt blocks access, WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions now presents this as a normal result, as it does locally, instead of raising a tool error. In cloud or self-hosted runner sessions, when a search is denied with a 403 response that includes a reason, that reason is now shown instead of just “Authentication error”.

items.original:
Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions
Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authentication error"
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the repository picker saying "No repositories match" while a search was still running; it now shows "Searching…" until the results arrive
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the "Waiting for a runner" status on self-hosted environments being cut off; with on-demand runners it now counts up from your last message and shows failed attempts

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器預設掛鉤超時上限，防止殘留程序佔用槽位
title.en: Self-hosted runners add a default hook timeout and prevent leftover processes from occupying slots

body.zh-TW: 自行架設執行器（Self-hosted runner）跑自動化流程的人，這版要留意四項改動。專案準備階段的 checkout 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在預設以 30 分鐘為限，超時會直接判定設定失敗；若任務需要更久，可自訂 `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` 延長時間或設為 `0` 解除上限。過去若在掛鉤執行期間封存或重新排入工作階段，或停止執行器，掛鉤的行程會留著繼續執行，執行器的槽位也一直被佔住，這已修好。啟用 `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` 時，也不會再誤將前一次工作階段留下的 `.claude/settings.local.json` 提交進版本控制中。替 Anthropic 管理的 Git 建立憑證檔案時，現在比照 CLI 過濾受信任憑證，並以 `[runner:warn]` 記錄排除數量。
body.en: If you run automation on a self-hosted runner, there are four changes to note in this release. Checkout hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) during project preparation now have a default limit of 30 minutes, after which setup is marked as failed. If a task needs longer, use `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` to extend the limit or set it to `0` to remove the limit. Previously, archiving or requeuing a session while a hook was running, or stopping the runner, left the hook's process running and kept the runner's slot occupied. This has been fixed. With `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` enabled, `.claude/settings.local.json` left over from a previous session is also no longer mistakenly committed to version control. When creating certificate files for Anthropic-managed Git, the runner now filters trusted certificates the same way as the CLI and logs the number excluded with `[runner:warn]`.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session
Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held
Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0`
Self-hosted runner: Changed the certificate file built for Anthropic-managed git to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does; a `[runner:warn]` line gives the number left out

title.zh-TW: VS Code 限制展開提示詞高度，修正 LaTeX 數學式貼上格式
title.en: VS Code limits expanded prompt height and fixes pasted LaTeX formatting

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 中使用 Claude Code 撰寫複雜指示或整理筆記時，對話框排版與文字貼上體驗更為順暢。過去只要點擊 Show more 展開較長的提示詞，整張輸入卡片會直接霸佔整個對話面板；現在釘選的提示詞高度被限制在面板的 40% 以內，超出範圍時會自動產生捲軸方便上下滾動。當你複製含有 LaTeX 數學式的清單項目或表格儲存格時，貼進富文字編輯器中不會再被錯誤切碎成全新的清單或表格。遇到擴充套件重啟後殘留的 Claude 背景行程時，「仍在其他地方開啟」的提示視窗現在也能清楚識別，並說明該行程通常在約 10 分鐘內便會自行退出。以前長文字一展開就遮蔽對話歷史、貼上公式格式又容易碎裂，現在排版邊界更穩定，編輯與查閱操作不再互相打架。
body.en: Writing complex instructions or organizing notes with Claude Code in VS Code now feels smoother, with better conversation layouts and text pasting. Previously, clicking Show more to expand a long prompt made the entire input card take over the conversation panel. Pinned prompts are now limited to 40% of the panel’s height, with a scrollbar appearing automatically when the content exceeds that limit. When you copy list items or table cells containing LaTeX equations into a rich text editor, they no longer get incorrectly split into new lists or tables. The “still open elsewhere” dialog now clearly identifies Claude background processes left over after an extension restart and explains that they usually exit on their own within about 10 minutes. Previously, expanding long text obscured the conversation history, and pasting equations could break their formatting. With more stable layout boundaries, editing and reviewing no longer get in each other’s way.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a long prompt expanded with Show more covering the whole chat panel: a pinned prompt is now capped at 40% of the panel and scrolls
[VSCode] Fixed part of a list item or table cell with LaTeX math pasting as a new list or table in rich text editors
[VSCode] Changed the "still open somewhere else" notice to also cover a Claude process left over from an extension restart, which usually ends on its own within about 10 minutes

title.zh-TW: VS Code 語音聽寫新增中斷提示，完善 TLS 憑證支援
title.en: VS Code voice dictation adds stop explanations and improves TLS certificate support

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡對著麥克風念出程式碼需求時，自動停止的機制與公司內網憑證相容性已經獲得完善。當語音聽寫因連續 15 秒沒有辨識出語音或達到 2 分鐘上限而自動關閉時，麥克風按鈕會跳出說明告知原因，並確認剛才說過的文字皆已妥善保留。針對經 TLS 封包檢查的代理網路，若僅在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 設定 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 曾導致聽寫連線失敗，現在已修好，聽寫也會遵循 `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`。語音聽寫與擴充套件本身的請求，現在都比照 CLI 過濾受信任憑證。擴充套件本身的請求也會信任環境變數或使用者設定指定的 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 憑證檔案。
body.en: When you dictate coding requirements into a microphone in VS Code, automatic stopping and compatibility with corporate network certificates now work more reliably. If voice dictation stops automatically after 15 consecutive seconds without recognized speech or upon reaching the 2-minute limit, the microphone button displays an explanation and confirms that everything you dictated has been preserved. On proxy networks with TLS inspection, setting `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` only in `~/.claude/settings.json` could cause dictation connections to fail. This is now fixed, and dictation also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`. Voice dictation and the extension’s own requests now filter trusted certificates the same way the CLI does. The extension’s own requests also trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` certificate file specified through environment variables or user settings.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a notice on the microphone button when voice dictation stops by itself (15 seconds without recognized speech, or the 2-minute limit), saying why and that the text so far is kept
[VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`
[VSCode] Changed voice dictation to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does
[VSCode] Changed the extension's own requests to filter their trusted certificates as the CLI does, and to trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file named in the environment or in user settings

title.zh-TW: /config 支援跨類別搜尋設定，即時修改並提示重啟
title.en: /config Supports Cross-Category Setting Search, Instant Edits, and Restart Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你想調整 Codex 的各項參數，卻記不清具體設定名稱藏在哪個分類時，現在直接輸入 `/config` 就能解決。⟦彷彿走進大型量販店使用智慧導覽機，以前要一層層貨架慢慢找商品，現在直接搜尋關鍵字就能立刻取貨，機器還會貼心提醒哪些生鮮結帳後必須馬上冷藏。⟧輸入 `/config` 後，你可以跨越不同分類快速搜尋偏好設定，支援的選項能當場修改；哪些變更需要重啟，介面也會清楚標示，不必再自己猜測設定是否需要重啟。
body.en: When you want to adjust parameters in Codex but cannot recall which category a specific setting is tucked under, typing `/config` now solves the problem immediately. ⟦Picture using a smart kiosk in a large wholesale store: previously you had to browse through aisle after aisle of shelves to find an item, but now searching by keyword lets you pick it up immediately, and the machine even helpfully reminds you which perishables must be refrigerated right after checkout.⟧ After entering `/config`, you can quickly search for preferences across different categories, and supported options can be modified on the spot. The interface also clearly indicates which changes require a restart, sparing you from guessing whether a setting demands one.

items.original: Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)

title.zh-TW: 生成中途可即時追問轉向，中斷時同步停止程式碼與工具呼叫
title.en: Steer Generations Mid-Stream with Follow-Up Prompts, Halting Code and Tool Calls on Interrupt

body.zh-TW: 看著 AI 劈頭往錯誤的方向洋洋灑灑寫下去，你不用再乾等它講完廢話才能打字糾正。⟦好比教練在場邊即時對球員大喊變更戰術，以前只能眼睜睜看著整套戰術打完才能檢討，現在哨音一響場上球員立刻改變跑位，正在熱身準備上場的替補球員也會全部停下動作。⟧Codex 正在回答的當下，你可以隨時送出後續追問來即時引導思考方向。如果你決定中斷這次回應，正在執行的 Code Mode（逐格執行程式碼的模式）儲存格會立刻停止，連同其巢狀工具呼叫也一併結束，避免背景程序白白空轉。
body.en: Watching the AI dash off in the wrong direction with paragraph after paragraph, you no longer have to wait idly until it finishes before typing a correction. ⟦Think of a coach shouting tactical changes from the sidelines to players in real time: previously you had to watch the entire play run its course before reviewing it, but now players shift positions the moment the whistle blows, while bench substitutes warming up to enter the game halt their movements as well.⟧ While Codex is in the middle of responding, you can send follow-up prompts at any time to steer its train of thought on the fly. If you decide to interrupt the response, currently executing Code Mode (a mode that executes code cell by cell) cells stop immediately, and their nested tool calls are terminated alongside them, preventing background processes from spinning in vain.

items.original: Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)

title.zh-TW: /keymap 支援自訂前導鍵，快捷鍵提示常駐且語音靜音改為 F9
title.en: /keymap Supports Custom Leader Keys, Sticky Shortcut Prompts, and Moves Voice Mute to F9

body.zh-TW: 習慣用鍵盤快速叫出各種操作的讀者，現在調整自訂按鍵更加得心應手。⟦如同樂團指揮設定了預備拍，以前比劃動作稍縱即逝容易漏看，現在提示手勢會穩穩停在空中等你接招，也把靜音操作換到另一個指定琴鍵。⟧在 `/keymap` 設定中，你可以自由配置前導鍵（按下一組按鍵後等待後續指令的引導鍵），系統預設組合為 `Ctrl+X`。按下後跳出的快捷鍵提示會持續停留在畫面上，直到你做出選擇或取消為止。語音靜音功能則移到了 `F9` 按鍵。
body.en: Readers accustomed to invoking operations swiftly via the keyboard can now customize key bindings with far greater ease. ⟦Imagine an orchestra conductor establishing a preparatory beat: previously the fleeting gesture was easily missed, but now the cueing hand rests steadily in the air waiting for your response, while the mute control is reassigned to another designated piano key.⟧ Within `/keymap` settings, you can freely configure a leader key (a guiding key that waits for follow-up inputs once pressed), with the system defaulting to `Ctrl+X`. The shortcut prompt that appears after pressing it remains on screen until you make a choice or cancel. Voice muting has been moved to the `F9` key.

items.original: Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)

title.zh-TW: /daemon 支援重啟背景伺服器，中斷前主動警告並自動重連
title.en: /daemon Supports Restarting Background Servers with Disruption Warnings and Auto-Reconnect

body.zh-TW: 當背景執行的伺服器連線卡住或需要重載時，你不必再大費周章手動終止處理程序。⟦就像大樓總電源維護前廣播通知，以前電閘一拉整棟直接斷電，現在管理員會先警告哪些電梯與設備即將暫停，重啟完畢後還會自動幫大家把照明重新接通。⟧現在從 `/daemon` 指令就能直接重啟受管的背景伺服器（常駐在系統底層默默運作的背景程序）。重啟前，Codex 會先跳出警告，提醒這次重啟可能會中斷哪些進行中的工作。確認執行後，系統會在伺服器重啟完成時自動重新連線，省去手動重連的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: When a background server connection hangs or requires a reload, you no longer need to go through the hassle of manually killing the process. ⟦Consider a building announcement prior to main electrical maintenance: previously throwing the main switch cut power to the entire building without ceremony, but now the superintendent first warns which elevators and facilities will temporarily halt, and automatically reconnects lighting once the restart completes.⟧ You can now restart managed background servers (daemons running quietly at the system level) directly from the `/daemon` command. Before restarting, Codex displays a warning outlining which active tasks might be disrupted. Once confirmed, the system automatically reconnects as soon as the server finishes rebooting, eliminating tedious manual reconnection steps.

items.original: Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)

title.zh-TW: 唯讀工具支援平行執行，技能、記憶與對話紀錄查詢不再排隊
title.en: Read-Only Tools Support Parallel Execution: Skills, Memory, and Session History Queries No Longer Queue Up

body.zh-TW: 提問時需要 AI 同時調閱多項過往資訊的讀者，現在能感受到明顯更快的查詢反應。⟦跟圖書館調派多位館員同時分頭找書一樣，以前一個人要先找完歷史檔案才能去翻閱典藏技能，現在三位館員各自朝不同書架出發，找齊資料後一口氣交到你手上。⟧Codex 現在能夠平行（同時多工處理而不依序等待）執行彼此互不干擾的獨立唯讀工具。這項機制涵蓋了擴充技能檢索、記憶調閱，以及對話歷史紀錄查詢。這些互不衝突的讀取工作現在能同步展開，縮短等待回答的時間。
body.en: Readers whose questions require the AI to retrieve multiple pieces of past information at once will now notice noticeably faster query responses. ⟦A library dispatches multiple librarians to fetch books simultaneously: where one person previously had to search historical archives before checking archived skills, three librarians now head toward separate shelves at once and deliver everything into your hands the moment it is gathered.⟧ Codex can now execute mutually independent read-only tools in parallel (processing tasks concurrently without waiting in line). This mechanism covers skill retrieval, memory lookups, and session history queries. These non-conflicting read tasks now run concurrently, cutting down the wait time for answers.

items.original: Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)

title.zh-TW: Daybreak 模型對合格帳號預設啟用，codex exec 支援金鑰指定選用
title.en: Daybreak Model Enabled by Default for Eligible Accounts, with Key-Based Selection in codex exec

body.zh-TW: 想體驗最新 Daybreak 模型的讀者，只要帳號符合資格，打開程式就能直接用上。⟦宛若高鐵會員自動升級商務車廂，以前必須特地到櫃檯出示證件申請，現在符合條件的旅客刷票進站就能直接入座，在自動售票機輸入個人憑證也能順利劃位。⟧針對符合資格的帳號，Codex 現已預設啟用 Daybreak 模型。如果你習慣使用終端機指令 `codex exec` 執行任務，在伺服器提供存取權限的前提下，只要附上 OpenAI API 金鑰（存取雲端服務的通關密鑰），也能透過該指令自由選用 Daybreak 模型。
body.en: Readers eager to experience the latest Daybreak model can now use it right out of the box, provided their account is eligible. ⟦A high-speed rail membership automatically upgrades passengers to business class: where travelers once had to present identification at the counter to apply, eligible passengers can now swipe their tickets at the gate to take their seats directly, while entering personal credentials at automated ticketing machines also secures a seat smoothly.⟧ Codex now enables the Daybreak model by default for eligible accounts. If you prefer running tasks with the terminal command `codex exec`, you can also freely select the Daybreak model through that command by supplying an OpenAI API key (the secret pass for accessing cloud services), provided the server grants access.

items.original: Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

title.zh-TW: 對話串切換支援 /side 回到分支，重啟時完整恢復授權與網路許可
title.en: Thread Switching Supports /side to Return to Branches, Fully Restoring Authorizations and Network Permissions on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 頻繁在多個任務之間切換對話串（在同一專案中分頭進行的獨立對話紀錄）的讀者，現在不用擔心進度與設定跑位。⟦有如在辦公室借調多份專案公文，以前換個案子審核印章就得重新蓋過，現在換回舊案能直接調閱已批准的用印紀錄，派出去的公文回函也會精準送回當初發文的專案夾。⟧切換對話串後，你可以隨時輸入 `/side` 指令回到先前的旁支對話。如果切換前有尚未回覆完畢的提示詞，產生的答案也會準確送回當初提問的對話串。當你重新打開已保存的對話串時，先前擁有的權限與網路存取許可都會完整還原，同時依然遵守手動覆寫與現行的管理政策。
body.en: Readers who frequently switch between threads (independent conversation logs running concurrently in the same project) no longer need to worry about losing progress or configuration state. ⟦Handling multiple project dossiers in an office setting once required restamping approvals whenever you switched cases, but returning to an earlier case now pulls up previously approved seal records directly, and replies to dispatched memos return precisely to the originating project folder.⟧ After switching threads, you can type the `/side` command at any point to return to a previous side discussion. If a prompt was still generating when you switched, the resulting response is routed accurately back to the thread where the question originated. When reopening a saved thread, your previously granted authorizations and network access permissions are fully restored, while continuing to respect manual overrides and active administrative policies.

items.original:
Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)

title.zh-TW: 網路代理加強防護：DNS 查詢前先審核、阻擋重複標頭與憑證別名繞過
title.en: Network Proxy Security Tightens: Pre-DNS Query Audits, Blocking Duplicate Headers and Credential Alias Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 在需要透過代理伺服器連接外部網路的環境中，這項更新替連線安全築起了更嚴格的防線。⟦猶如機場海關加強查驗流程，以前旅客報出目的地前不會先核驗護照，現在查驗官在查詢航線前就先確認出境許可，嚴查重複填寫的申報表，也不再讓換了別名的違禁證件繞過檢查站。⟧網路代理現在會在發起網域名稱查詢（將網址轉譯為伺服器位址的查詢）前，先行檢查該連線是否具備相應權限。代理伺服器也會主動拒絕帶有重複 `Host` 標頭的請求，並防止憑證別名繞過檢查掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），杜絕未經授權的潛在連線漏洞。
body.en: In environments that route external network traffic through a proxy server, this update erects a stricter line of defense for connection security. ⟦Customs inspectors at an airport checkpoint tighten screening procedures: where officers previously did not verify passports before travelers stated their destinations, inspectors now confirm exit permits before looking up flight routes, strictly scrutinize duplicate declaration forms, and block contraband credentials disguised under aliases from slipping past checkpoints.⟧ The network proxy now verifies whether a connection holds appropriate permissions before initiating a domain name query (resolving a web address into a server destination). The proxy server also actively rejects requests bearing duplicate `Host` headers and prevents credential aliases from bypassing check hooks (small routines triggered when specific events occur), plugging potential unauthorized connection loopholes.

items.original: The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援快捷鍵貼圖，WSL 剪貼簿重複讀取並防止複製卡死
title.en: Windows Gains Image Pasting Shortcuts, While WSL Reuses Clipboard Readers and Prevents Copy Freezes

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 或 WSL（Windows 系統內建的 Linux 子系統）環境下操作終端機的讀者，剪貼內容時將順暢許多。⟦恰似換了一組靈敏的櫃檯讀卡機，兩組指定快捷鍵都能把文字與圖片直接貼進視窗；頻繁讀取時能共用讀取模組，複製操作也會逾時退出，不再一直卡住。⟧在 Windows 中，`Ctrl+V` 與 `Shift+Insert` 現在都能貼上文字與圖片。而在 WSL 環境下，連續多次貼上會重複使用剪貼簿讀取器；複製操作在遇到阻礙時則會逾時退出，不再無休止地卡死畫面。
body.en: Readers running terminals under Windows or WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) will experience far smoother clipboard workflows. ⟦Upgrading to a responsive card reader at a checkout counter allows two designated shortcuts to feed both text and images straight into the window, frequent scans share the reader module, and stalled copy operations time out instead of hanging indefinitely.⟧ On Windows, both `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` can now paste text and images. Under WSL, successive pastes reuse the clipboard reader, while copy operations encountering obstacles time out gracefully rather than freezing the screen indefinitely.

items.original: On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)

title.zh-TW: 指令輸出修復：本地與遠端傳輸更穩，codex exec 不再重複印出差異
title.en: Command Output Fixes: Steadier Local and Remote Transfers, codex exec Stops Reprinting Diffs

body.zh-TW: 經常在終端機執行本機指令或遠端遙控工作的讀者，這次更新修復了多項令指令卡住或資訊混亂的輸出問題。⟦宛如貨運物流中心整頓了出貨流程，以前只要下游包裝箱還沒封口，送貨司機就算卸完貨也只能在原地枯等，現在確認卸貨完成就能迅速出發，晚到的包裹也能妥善入庫而不被遺漏。⟧以前執行本機指令時，只要底層的子行程（由主程式衍生出來獨立處理任務的分支程式）沒有關閉輸出管道，整個指令就會乾等而不肯結束。現在本地指令在工作完成後能迅速結束。執行遠端指令時，晚到的輸出內容現在會妥善保留，確保最後一次輪詢時依然能完整收集。使用 `codex exec` 執行無關指令後，終端機也不會再重複印出先前的檔案差異清單。
body.en: For readers who regularly run local commands or remote tasks in the terminal, this update resolves several output glitches that previously hung commands or cluttered information. ⟦A freight logistics hub overhauls its shipping workflow: previously, as long as downstream packing crates remained unsealed, delivery drivers had to wait idly on site even after finishing unloading, but now drivers depart promptly once unloading is confirmed, and late-arriving parcels are safely warehoused rather than missed.⟧ Previously when running local commands, as long as underlying subprocesses (child processes spawned by the main program to handle tasks independently) kept output pipes open, the overall command would stall indefinitely rather than terminate. Local commands now exit promptly once their work is done. When executing remote commands, late-arriving output is now safely retained, ensuring it is fully collected during the final poll. Running unrelated commands via `codex exec` also no longer causes the terminal to reprint previous file diffs.

items.original:
Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
`codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

title.zh-TW: 隨附技術文件更新：收錄 GPT-6 遷移指引與 Linux 沙箱架構說明
title.en: Bundled Documentation Update: GPT-6 Migration Guide and Linux Sandbox Architecture Details

body.zh-TW: 正在規劃將專案升級至新世代模型，或關注系統底層安全防護的讀者，現在能從隨附文件中查閱更詳盡的官方指南。⟦正如工廠設備手冊換上新版擴建指南，不僅詳細列出升級新型機具時的運轉特性與資料所在地考量，也公開了安全防護罩如何隔絕危險區域並過濾高壓氣流。⟧隨附的 OpenAI 文件已更新針對 GPT-6 系列模型的遷移指引，詳細說明了各模型特定的推理特性、外部工具使用方式，以及資料駐留（資料儲存與處理的地理位置）相關考量。隨附說明也進一步釐清了 Linux 沙箱機制的運作方式，詳細介紹系統如何透過 bubblewrap 達成檔案系統隔離，並藉由 seccomp 進行系統呼叫過濾。
body.en: Readers planning to upgrade projects to next-generation models or keeping an eye on low-level system security can now consult more detailed official guidance in the bundled documentation. ⟦A factory equipment manual swaps in a fresh expansion guide, not only detailing the operational characteristics and data location considerations when upgrading to new machinery, but also revealing how safety shields isolate hazardous areas and filter high-pressure airflow.⟧ The bundled OpenAI documentation updates migration guidance for the GPT-6 model family, detailing model-specific reasoning characteristics, external tool usage, and data residency (the geographic location where data is stored and processed) considerations. The bundled documentation also clarifies how the Linux sandbox mechanism operates, detailing how the system achieves filesystem isolation through bubblewrap and filters system calls via seccomp.

items.original:
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

title.zh-TW: 安裝包體積縮減，改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器並提示設定遷移
title.en: Package Size Reduced with Codex's Standard Shell Runner and Config Migration Notice

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 與 macOS 環境下安裝或更新 Codex 的讀者，這次會發現下載更輕盈且底層執行器更單純。⟦與出差輕裝上陣的概念相同，以前行李箱裡硬塞了一整套自備工具組，現在改用原有的標準工具，並把非必要的裝飾吊牌全數卸下，讓行李箱體積與重量減輕不少。⟧官方透過從安裝二進位檔中剝除符號（除錯用的內部名稱標籤），縮減了 Linux 與 macOS 版本的安裝套件體積，原始建置產物則依然保留完整符號。在執行架構上，Codex 現在改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器（負責執行命令的工具），不再隨附修補版的 `zsh`。如果既有設定仍包含已淘汰的 shell 標記，系統會跳出遷移通知協助你平順過渡。
body.en: Readers installing or updating Codex on Linux and macOS will find lighter downloads and a simpler underlying runner. ⟦A business traveler packs light under the same principle: rather than stuffing a custom toolkit into a suitcase, they rely on existing standard tools and strip away nonessential decorative tags, significantly reducing suitcase size and weight.⟧ The team reduced package sizes for Linux and macOS releases by stripping symbols (internal name labels used for debugging) from installation binaries, while raw build artifacts still retain full symbols. In terms of execution architecture, Codex now switches to Codex's standard shell runner (a tool responsible for executing commands), no longer bundling a patched `zsh`. If existing configurations still contain deprecated shell flags, the system displays a migration notice to help you transition smoothly.

items.original:
Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

entries: Improved how agent responses read: a blank line now separates the collapsed thought block from the response, and once the response starts, the collapsed thought shows only its `Thought for …` header instead of repeating a snippet of the thinking; expand it to see the full thinking.

Improved `/` search in the `/diff` file view to count matches inside folded unchanged lines, such as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` or `no matches · +1 hidden`, and the `f` hint now reads `show N hidden matches`.

Improved `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` to mark the selected commit with the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of a highlighted bar, and made `Per Turn` start with the cursor on the first file instead of its turn header.

Improved recurring cron schedules created with the agent's `schedule` tool to fire at a consistent per-schedule offset instead of exactly on the cron boundary, to avoid traffic spikes: schedules that repeat within a day, such as every 30 minutes or hourly, now fire somewhere within their period, fixed-time schedules such as daily at 9:00 still fire within their scheduled minute, and the agent can request exact timing when a schedule needs it. `@every` schedules are unchanged.
Improved idle CPU usage by pausing screen refreshes while nothing on screen changes, roughly halving the CLI's CPU use when it is idle.
Improved CPU usage while a response streams by skipping redundant screen updates and refreshing the credit balance less often.
Improved rendering speed for long conversations, and made long conversations load faster when you resume them.
Improved startup CPU usage when the CLI refreshes its conversation summaries.
Improved memory usage by allocating storage for the prompt and other text inputs as you type instead of reserving it up front.
Fixed the agent silently retrying, potentially without end, when a model response was blocked by content safety filters.
Fixed plugins failing to load when `plugin.json` gives `skills` as a single path string, such as `"skills": "./skills/"`, instead of an array, as some plugins written for other tools do.
Fixed marketplace plugin installs and automatic updates failing with a checksum mismatch or network error when a download was briefly stale or interrupted; the CLI now retries the download once.

title.zh-TW: 回覆正文與收合思考區塊空行區隔，頂端僅保留標題
title.en: Blank line separates response text from collapsed thought block, leaving only the header at the top

body.zh-TW: 閱讀代理人剛生成的回覆時，若思考過程與正文擠成一團，往往會打斷閱讀節奏。⟦像在會議中翻閱專案報告，以前草稿筆記直接黏在結論上方容易分散焦點；現在頂端只留一張寫著構思時間的簡潔書籤，中間隔出一行空白，正文一目了然，需要時再翻開整份草稿。⟧現在代理人開始輸出回覆後，收合的思考區塊只會顯示 `Thought for …` 標題，不再重複列出思考過程的文字片段。收合的思考區塊與正文之間也多了一行空行隔開，文字段落不會再擠在一起。如果你想確認剛才完整的推導邏輯，只要手動展開該區塊，依然能查閱完整的思考內容。
body.en: When reading a newly generated response from an agent, having the thought process clustered against the main text often breaks your reading flow. ⟦Picture reviewing a project report during a meeting: previously, draft notes stuck directly above the conclusion would distract focus, whereas now only a neat bookmark noting thinking time remains at the top with a blank line in between, keeping the main text clear at a glance while letting you unfold the full draft whenever needed.⟧ Now, once the agent begins outputting a response, the collapsed thought block only displays the `Thought for …` header instead of repeating text snippets from the thought process. A blank line also separates the collapsed thought block from the main text, so text paragraphs no longer bunch together. If you want to verify the complete reasoning logic behind it, you can still view the full thoughts simply by expanding the block manually.

items.original: Improved how agent responses read: a blank line now separates the collapsed thought block from the response, and once the response starts, the collapsed thought shows only its `Thought for …` header instead of repeating a snippet of the thinking; expand it to see the full thinking.

title.zh-TW: 比對檢視支援折疊搜尋計數，游標樣式與停駐位置對齊
title.en: Diff view supports folded search counts, aligning cursor style and resting position

body.zh-TW: 檢閱程式碼變更時，折疊起來的未更動行數常讓搜尋結果變得難以掌握。⟦好比翻閱厚重的帳冊索引，以前夾在折頁裡的項目算不進筆數，各分冊的標記色塊也不一致；現在標籤直接註記折疊處藏有幾筆帳目，選取欄位也統一換成箭頭符號，翻到當前回合就直接對準第一筆明細。⟧在 `/diff` 檔案檢視中以 `/` 搜尋時，工具現在會計算折疊行內的相符項目，以 `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` 顯示隱藏數量，`f` 鍵展開提示也改為 `show N hidden matches`。介面上，`Commit Tree` 改用與 `All Changes` 及 `Per Turn` 相同的 `>` 游標與選取色，不再用高亮色塊；切換到 `Per Turn` 時游標也會直接停在第一個檔案，不必再跳過回合標題。
body.en: When reviewing code changes, collapsed unchanged lines often make search results hard to track. ⟦Much like browsing a thick ledger index, items tucked inside folded pages were previously excluded from match counts and marker color blocks across volumes were inconsistent, whereas tabs now directly annotate how many entries are hidden in folds, selection columns uniformly switch to arrow symbols, and turning to the current turn lands straight on the first detail.⟧ When searching with `/` inside the `/diff` file view, the tool now counts matches within folded lines, displaying the hidden count as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden`, and the `f` key expand hint is now updated to `show N hidden matches`. On the interface, `Commit Tree` now uses the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of highlight blocks; when switching to `Per Turn`, the cursor also rests directly on the first file without needing to skip past turn headers.

items.original:
Improved `/` search in the `/diff` file view to count matches inside folded unchanged lines, such as `match 2/5 · +3 hidden` or `no matches · +1 hidden`, and the `f` hint now reads `show N hidden matches`.
Improved `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` to mark the selected commit with the same `>` cursor and selection color as `All Changes` and `Per Turn` instead of a highlighted bar, and made `Per Turn` start with the cursor on the first file instead of its turn header.

title.zh-TW: 循環排程引入偏移時間差，避免整點邊界流量暴增
title.en: Recurring schedules introduce time offsets to prevent traffic spikes on hour boundaries

body.zh-TW: 若有多個背景任務排在整點同時啟動，瞬間湧入的連線很容易讓伺服器塞車。⟦跟社區大樓安排住戶分流一樣，以前所有單位全擠在整點出門容易在閘門大塞車；現在為每個單位分配固定的前後時間差，整點前後平順出發，需要分秒不差的專車依然能申請在準點出發。⟧由代理人透過 `schedule` 工具建立的循環 cron 排程，現在觸發時會依每個排程套用固定的偏移時間，不再剛好卡在整點邊界，有效分散尖峰流量。在一天內多次重複的任務（例如每 30 分鐘或每小時一次），會在各自週期內的特定時間點觸發。每天早上 9:00 等固定時間排程，依然會在預定的該分鐘內執行。若排程需要嚴格對準時刻，代理人也能要求精確時間，而 `@every` 間隔排程則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When multiple background tasks are scheduled to launch at the same time on the hour, an instant surge of connections easily congests the server. ⟦Just as a residential complex staggers departures for its tenants, having every household head out right on the hour previously caused massive gate congestion, but assigning a fixed offset window to each unit now smooths out traffic around the hour while reserved shuttles that require exact timing can still request sharp departure times.⟧ Recurring cron schedules created by an agent via the `schedule` tool now apply a fixed offset time to each schedule when triggered, no longer landing exactly on hour boundaries and effectively spreading out peak traffic. Tasks that repeat multiple times throughout the day (such as every 30 minutes or once an hour) trigger at specific points within their respective intervals. Fixed-time schedules like 9:00 AM every morning still execute within their scheduled minute. If a schedule requires strict time alignment, the agent can also request exact timing, while `@every` interval schedules remain unchanged.

items.original: Improved recurring cron schedules created with the agent's `schedule` tool to fire at a consistent per-schedule offset instead of exactly on the cron boundary, to avoid traffic spikes: schedules that repeat within a day, such as every 30 minutes or hourly, now fire somewhere within their period, fixed-time schedules such as daily at 9:00 still fire within their scheduled minute, and the agent can request exact timing when a schedule needs it. `@every` schedules are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 降低閒置與執行資源消耗，長對話與啟動載入更流暢
title.en: Reduced idle and runtime resource consumption with smoother long conversations and startup loading

body.zh-TW:
長時間在終端機開啟工具或處理大型專案時，背景消耗的硬體資源現在明顯下降。

當畫面沒有任何文字變動時，終端機會暫停螢幕重繪，讓閒置時的 CPU 使用率約減少一半。而在模型輸出串流回覆的過程中，工具會略過重複的畫面更新，並降低額度餘額的刷新頻率以節省運算效能。

長篇對話的渲染效能有所改善，重新恢復長對話工作階段時的載入速度也提升。命令列介面啟動並刷新對話摘要時，CPU 開銷也一併降低。

在記憶體管理方面，輸入提示詞與各類文字時改為打字時才動態配置儲存空間，不再預先保留整塊記憶體。閒置時的 CPU 消耗降低，長對話顯示與恢復載入也更快。
body.en:
When keeping the tool open in the terminal for long periods or working on large projects, background hardware resource consumption has now noticeably decreased.

When there are no text changes on screen, the terminal pauses screen repaints, cutting idle CPU usage roughly in half. Meanwhile, while the model streams output, the tool skips redundant screen redraws and lowers the refresh frequency of quota balances to save computing power.

Rendering performance for long conversations has improved, and loading speed when resuming long conversation sessions has also increased. When the command-line interface launches and refreshes conversation summaries, CPU overhead is similarly reduced.

Regarding memory management, storage space for prompt inputs and various texts is now dynamically allocated during typing instead of pre-allocating entire memory blocks. Idle CPU consumption drops, and long conversation display as well as resumption loading become faster.

items.original:
Improved idle CPU usage by pausing screen refreshes while nothing on screen changes, roughly halving the CLI's CPU use when it is idle.
Improved CPU usage while a response streams by skipping redundant screen updates and refreshing the credit balance less often.
Improved rendering speed for long conversations, and made long conversations load faster when you resume them.
Improved startup CPU usage when the CLI refreshes its conversation summaries.
Improved memory usage by allocating storage for the prompt and other text inputs as you type instead of reserving it up front.

title.zh-TW: 模型遭安全機制阻擋時停止無止盡重試
title.en: Stop infinite retries when the model is blocked by safety mechanisms

body.zh-TW: 遇上模型回覆被內容安全過濾機制阻擋的突發狀況，代理人過去容易陷入停不下來的重試迴圈。以前遇到回應被安全過濾器阻擋時，代理人會在背景靜默重試，甚至可能陷入無止盡的重試迴圈；現在這個問題已經修好，遇到阻擋時不再默默持續重試。
body.en: When encountering unexpected situations where a model response was blocked by content safety filters, agents previously tended to get trapped in an endless retry loop. In the past, when a response was blocked by safety filters, the agent would silently retry in the background and could even enter an infinite retry loop; this issue has now been resolved, and it no longer keeps silently retrying when blocked.

items.original: Fixed the agent silently retrying, potentially without end, when a model response was blocked by content safety filters.

title.zh-TW: 外掛設定支援以字串指定技能路徑，避免載入失敗
title.en: Plugin configuration supports specifying skill paths as strings to prevent loading failures

body.zh-TW: 想載入為其他工具設計的外掛程式時，設定檔格式只要稍有不同就會直接報錯。以前如果外掛的 `plugin.json` 將 `skills` 欄位寫成單一路徑字串（例如 `"skills": "./skills/"`）而非陣列清單，外掛就會載入失敗。現在這個問題已經修好，工具能正確辨識單一路徑字串並完成載入。
body.en: When trying to load plugins designed for other tools, any slight difference in configuration format would directly trigger an error. Previously, if a plugin's `plugin.json` specified the `skills` field as a single path string (such as `"skills": "./skills/"`) instead of an array list, the plugin failed to load. This issue has now been resolved, and the tool correctly recognizes a single path string and completes loading.

items.original: Fixed plugins failing to load when `plugin.json` gives `skills` as a single path string, such as `"skills": "./skills/"`, instead of an array, as some plugins written for other tools do.

title.zh-TW: 市集外掛安裝與更新遇網路中斷自動重試一次
title.en: Marketplace plugin installation and updates automatically retry once on network interruption

body.zh-TW: 從市集安裝或自動更新外掛程式時，偶發的網路震盪容易造成程序中斷。以前下載內容短暫過時或下載中斷時，市集外掛安裝與自動更新可能因校驗碼不符或網路錯誤而失敗；現在命令列介面會自動重試下載一次。
body.en: When installing or automatically updating plugins from the marketplace, occasional network disruptions easily interrupted the process. Previously, when downloaded content was temporarily stale or downloads were interrupted, marketplace plugin installations and automatic updates could fail due to checksum mismatches or network errors; the command-line interface now automatically retries the download once.

items.original: Fixed marketplace plugin installs and automatic updates failing with a checksum mismatch or network error when a download was briefly stale or interrupted; the CLI now retries the download once.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式等待背景工作接續對話，逾時中斷改回傳錯誤
title.en: Headless mode waits for background follow-up turns and exits with error on timeout

body.zh-TW: 當你寫腳本透過指令列自動處理任務時，最怕背景工作還沒做完程式就提早離場。使用 `grok -p` 啟動無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）時，若已完成的背景工作觸發了接續對話，現在會耐心等待該輪對話結束後才退出。⟦如同自助洗衣機的運轉流程，以前主行程一結束就立刻切斷電源，不管追加的防皺運轉跑完了沒有；現在機器會等接續動作徹底收尾才關機，要是設定的時間上限強行中斷了未完工項，面板更會亮起錯誤紅燈而不是回報順利完成。⟧如果加上 `--background-wait-timeout` 參數且因逾時停止了待處理工作，程式結束時會回傳錯誤代碼，不再誤報為成功執行。
body.en: When scripting automated tasks through the command line, the biggest risk is a process exiting prematurely before background work finishes. When launching headless mode (an execution mode with no terminal screen) with `grok -p`, if completed background tasks trigger follow-up conversation turns, the runner now waits patiently for that turn to conclude before exiting. ⟦Like the cycle of a laundromat washing machine, the power previously cut off the moment the main cycle finished, regardless of whether the extra anti-wrinkle cycle had completed; now the machine shuts down only after follow-up actions wrap up completely, and if a configured time limit forcibly stops unfinished work, the panel flashes a red error light instead of reporting a successful run.⟧ If you provide the `--background-wait-timeout` option and pending work is stopped due to a timeout, the program now exits with an error code instead of falsely reporting success.

items.original: Headless mode (`grok -p`) waits for the follow-up turn that a finished background task starts before exiting, and a `--background-wait-timeout` that stops pending work exits with an error instead of success

title.zh-TW: 儀表板冷啟動恢復工作階段，保持浮層開啟並支援按鍵返回
title.en: Dashboard cold boot resumes sessions while keeping popover open with keyboard back navigation

body.zh-TW: 你在儀表板翻找過去的歷史紀錄時，可能會想先點進某個舊存檔看看進度。在儀表板浮層中針對未預載的存檔執行冷啟動 `/resume` 時，介面現在會讓浮動面板保持附著開啟。⟦彷彿在電子導覽機前點選歷史路徑，以前只要觸控未預載的深層檔案，選單面板就會冷不防關閉脫離，讓人想反悔返回都無從按起；現在清單畫面會持續固定在視野中，隨時都能按上一頁安全退回。⟧如此一來，載入舊工作階段時不會丟失操作畫面，你可以隨時按下向左方向鍵（Left）或 `Ctrl+\` 順利退出，返回原本的清單繼續瀏覽。
body.en: When browsing past history in the dashboard, you might want to open an older saved state to inspect its progress. Triggering a cold `/resume` on an unloaded session from the dashboard popover now keeps the floating panel open and attached. ⟦At a digital directory kiosk, tapping an unloaded deep record previously caused the menu panel to snap shut and detach unexpectedly, leaving no way to step back; now the list display stays anchored in view so you can safely return at any moment.⟧ This way, you never lose your context when loading an older session, and you can press the Left arrow key (Left) or `Ctrl+\` at any time to exit cleanly and return to the list.

items.original: Cold `/resume` from the dashboard overlay keeps the overlay attached, so you can still back out with Left or `Ctrl+\`

title.zh-TW: 選取帶參數斜線指令按 Enter 直接執行，不再殘留空格
title.en: Selecting slash commands with arguments and pressing Enter executes immediately without trailing spaces

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入框使用斜線指令時，大家常會透過選單挑選想跑的動作。當你在提示詞撰寫區反白選取帶有可選參數的斜線指令並按下 Enter 鍵時，現在會立刻執行該指令。以前輸入框（composer，撰寫提示詞的文字區）只會在指令後面留下一格多餘的空格，停在原地等待你再次確認。⟦好比在車載導航螢幕上選取附帶途經點的路線，以前按下確認鈕，畫面只會在輸入欄末端留下一格空白等候；現在一按便直接開始指引，不再卡在輸入框等待多餘的操作。⟧這樣不必在選好指令後還得手動多敲一次鍵，命令一選定就能順暢送出。
body.en: When using slash commands in the terminal input box, users often pick actions from the menu. Selecting a slash command with optional arguments in the prompt area and pressing Enter now executes that command immediately. Previously, the composer (the text area for writing prompts) only appended an extra space after the command, sitting idle while waiting for your confirmation. ⟦On an in-car navigation screen, selecting a route with waypoints and hitting confirm previously only left a blank space at the end of the input field; now a single press starts guidance immediately instead of stalling for redundant input.⟧ You no longer need to press an extra key manually after choosing a command, allowing selected actions to submit smoothly.

items.original: Enter on a highlighted slash command with optional arguments runs the command instead of leaving a trailing space in the composer

title.zh-TW: 多項 CLI 指令支援管道提早關閉與串流限制，避免輸出異常崩潰
title.en: Multiple CLI commands handle early pipe closures and stream limits without crashing

body.zh-TW: 平時在終端機串接多道指令過濾資料時，下游工具提早結束往往會引發非預期的中斷。包含 `grok models`、列出工作階段的 `grok sessions` 與 `grok export` 等指令，當輸出管道提早關閉（例如串接 `head` 只取前幾行）或輸出裝置已滿時，現在都不再發生當機。⟦就像工廠輸送帶上的分裝包裝線，以前只要下游集貨箱裝滿或接收閘門提早關閉，傳送機械便會當場卡死並引發整條產線警報；現在機台一旦察覺出口無法收件，就會平順停止輸出並安穩關機。⟧`grok update` 與 `grok login` 兩項指令在標準輸出（stdout）或標準錯誤關閉且無法寫入時，現在同樣能安全結束，確保批次腳本不再因串流截斷而崩潰。
body.en: When piping multiple commands in the terminal to filter data, a downstream tool exiting early often triggers unexpected disruptions. Commands including `grok models`, `grok sessions` for listing sessions, and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early (such as when piped into `head` for the first few lines) or when the output device fills up. ⟦In a factory conveyor packaging line, if a downstream collection bin filled up or a receiving gate closed early, the transport machinery previously jammed on the spot and triggered plant-wide alarms; now the equipment halts output smoothly and shuts down safely as soon as it detects that the exit cannot accept packages.⟧ `grok update` and `grok login` now also exit safely when standard output (stdout) or standard error is closed and unwritable, ensuring batch scripts no longer crash due to truncated streams.

`grok update` and `grok login` no longer crash when stdout or stderr is closed or unwritable

title.zh-TW: 內建 `web3d` skill，幫你做單檔 3D 網頁和瀏覽器小遊戲
title.en: Built-in `web3d` skill builds single-file 3D web pages and browser games

body.zh-TW: 想做一個能在瀏覽器裡轉動的 3D 產品展示頁，或一款小遊戲，現在可以直接交給 Muse。內建的 `web3d` skill（教 AI 照固定步驟做某類工作的說明書）會引導它做出單檔的 3D 網頁或瀏覽器遊戲，交件前先開瀏覽器檢查。動工前，它會先規劃每個部分的形狀、周遭環境和材質；第一版能跑之後，再派一個全新的測試子代理實際玩一遍、寫下批評，批評沒處理完不准交件，審查輪數也有時間上限。⟦餐廳出菜前先請另一位廚師試吃挑毛病，挑出的問題改完才端上桌，但試吃不會無限輪下去。⟧你說「停」，或只要它打開頁面時，它會立刻停止檢查。
body.en: Want a 3D product page you can spin in the browser, or a small game? You can now hand it straight to Muse. The built-in `web3d` skill (a playbook that teaches the AI fixed steps for one kind of job) guides it in building single-file 3D web pages and browser games and checking them in a browser before handoff. Before building, it plans each part's shape, surroundings and materials; after the first working build, a fresh tester subagent plays the page and writes a critique that must be closed before delivery, with a time guard on review rounds. ⟦A kitchen has a second chef taste each dish and point out flaws before it goes out, but the tasting does not go on forever.⟧ When you say stop, or just ask it to open the page, it stops checking right away.

title.zh-TW: 新增 `/game-3d-visuals`，`/blender` 也能做一般 3D 工作
title.en: New `/game-3d-visuals`, and `/blender` takes on general 3D work

body.zh-TW: 手上有幾張參考圖，想做出長得一樣的 3D 模型或遊戲畫面？新的 `/game-3d-visuals` 指令會依參考圖和一份視覺規格驅動 3D 模型與遊戲製作，並反覆比對渲染圖（電腦算出來的成品畫面）和參考圖，直到合格。`/blender` 則擴大到 Blender 裡的一般 3D 工作：建模、照一張圖重建場景、動畫和大型環境都能做，附帶的輔助腳本在 Blender 4 和 5 都能用。它也能拿渲染圖跟參考圖對量，逐格檢查動畫有沒有突然跳動、物體下沉或跑出鏡頭。折射的反彈次數也保留得更多，疊在一起的玻璃不會再渲染得那麼暗。
body.en: Have a few reference images and want a 3D model or game scene that matches them? The new `/game-3d-visuals` command drives 3D models and games from reference images and a visual spec, comparing each render (the finished image the computer calculates) against the references until it passes. `/blender` now covers general 3D work in Blender: object modeling, recreating a scene from an image, animation and large environments, with helper scripts that work on Blender 4 and 5. It can also measure a render against its reference image and check animations frame by frame for pops, sinking and objects leaving the shot. It keeps more refraction bounces too, so stacked glass renders less dark.
